title: inFamous Second Son
summary: Delsin gains smoke, neon, and other superpowers in Seattle.

moments.label: An Alibi in the Longhouse
moments.detail: Delson sneaks into the longhouse to establish an alibi before getting caught.

moments.label: Conduit Awakening
moments.detail: Delson's first encounter with a crashed conduit leads to his powers awakening.

moments.label: First Fight with Smoke Powers
moments.detail: Delson fights his way through the tribe area using his new smoke abilities.

moments.label: Hank's Past and Escape
moments.detail: Hank Daughtry explains his history in prison and his escape with Delson.

moments.label: Augustine's Interrogation
moments.detail: Augustine questions Delson and threatens Betty to get information.

moments.label: Aftermath at the Longhouse
moments.detail: Delson wakes up to find the devastation Augustine left behind at the longhouse.

moments.label: Road Trip to Seattle
moments.detail: Delson and Reggie decide to head to Seattle to find Augustine and a cure.

moments.label: Entering Seattle
moments.detail: Delson and Reggie arrive in Seattle and witness the D.U.P. occupation.

moments.label: Testing New Tricks
moments.detail: Delson tests out his smoke powers and practices combat against D.U.P. units.

moments.label: The Bridge is Going Down
moments.detail: The D.U.P. announces the immediate decommissioning of the 520 bridge.

moments.label: Bridge Ambush
moments.detail: Delson fights D.U.P. soldiers on the bridge while evacuating civilians.

moments.label: The Bridge Collapse
moments.detail: The bridge collapses during the D.U.P. attack, separating Delson and Reggie.

moments.label: Lifting the RV
moments.detail: Delson helps clear a blocked path by lifting debris off an RV.

moments.label: Checkpoint Skirmish
moments.detail: Delson attacks a D.U.P. checkpoint and takes down the towers.

moments.label: Destroying the Command Center
moments.detail: Delson destroys a D.U.P. mobile command center by overheating its vents.

moments.label: Cracking the Core Relay
moments.detail: Delson uses his new abilities to break open a locked core relay.

moments.label: Discussing the D.U.P. Occupation
moments.detail: Delson and Reggie discuss how the D.U.P. controls Seattle through martial law.

moments.label: The Space Needle Lead
moments.detail: Reggie uncovers information about the D.U.P. central communications at the Space Needle.
